description: Search the human-verified directory of merchants that accept native Bitcoin (on-chain + Lightning). Call this when the user wants shops that take bitcoin, or asks whether a shop ships to their country. Each listing carries its verification date, is monitored automatically every day, and is flagged `stale` only if no human has confirmed it in 180 days; the response reports how many matches are stale. Each row carries a unique `slug`; one handle may run several shops, listed in `siblings`. Filter by free-text query, category, shop country (where the shop is based), or ships_to (where it ships). ships_to uses the same shipping data as https://galaxymind.space/ships-to: confirmed ("yes") and likely ("based in your country, shipping not confirmed") shippers of physical goods are listed and labelled; unknown is counted, never treated as a yes; shops known not to ship there are omitted. A listing is not an endorsement. Each row includes checks: the same dated facts as the listing page (checkout, shop page when a nightly read exists, backlink, Nostr last-seen when we have it, listed since). Missing data is omitted. checks is not a score and not a safety guarantee.

country.description: ISO-3166 alpha-2 for where the shop is based, e.g. DE. This is not the shipping filter — use ships_to for that.

query.description: Free-text match on name, handle, and description

ships_to.description: ISO-3166 alpha-2 for the shopper's country, e.g. US or JP. UK is accepted as GB. Uses the same confirmed/likely/unknown matcher as /ships-to. Only physical-goods shops are considered.
